fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook just inside the passes (C&R); surf mixed mangrove snapper, reds, snook, black drum, sheepshead; fall bait moving. LEMON BAY: reds schooling docks/flats; trout, mixed snook, black drum; Bull/Turtle Bay reds, smaller snook, trout; jacks in the mix. NEARSHORE: Spanish on bait schools; mangroves ~40 ft; reefs mixed snapper; gag season open through Sep 30. Baits: live shrimp, white bait/pinfish, cut ladyfish, spoons/soft plastics.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/21; gulf beaches Good).
fpl: Charlotte / Sarasota FPL outages quiet evening of 9/28 (statewide tracker low hundreds; no local spike noted).
